Fall sautieren! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Wie soll man ihn

When you boil a mitten crab, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}the

FR:

pour l'apéritif.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Allez, {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}viens par ici mon petit.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sois

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Guppys sind ziemlich klein, deshalb

Mengen{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.

Nibble fish.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Those are fantastic if

{{TAG:0003:0024:}}A poorly cooked fish is just a sad

bon pour le cerveau, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}parce que c'est
riche en phosphore. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Mouais...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}En tout cas,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je me sens toujours

{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Un pesce cucinato male mi

roh essen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Njuk njuk!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}

Doktor balığı.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nasıl

EN:
I've never tried it,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}but I'll bet dried
angelfish tastes pretty close to

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Right now I'm just gonna eat it raw
to save myself some time.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
Hablo solo de oídas,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} pero dicen que
el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pez ángel{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} seco sabe a cecina.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Cierto, habría que comprobarlo.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pero ahora no es el momento
de perder el tiempo haciendo
experimentos.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñuk!

J'en ai jamais mangé grillé,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}mais
je suis sûr que le poisson-ange au
gril doit avoir un goût paradisiaque.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ah... J'ai comme l'impression que
c'est pas aujourd'hui que je le
saurai...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
Non l'ho mai provato,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}ma sono

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Potrei sempre sbagliarmi, eh.

{{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM, GNAM e ancora GNAM!

Fleisch.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Nur so eine Theorie!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Im Moment ist mir aber eher nach

ich ihn so, wie er ist.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}

Hiç denemedim ama{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}kurutulmuş

benzediğine bahse girerim. Teori

için çiğ yiyeceğim.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}No veas lo bien que sienta comerse

ejemplar{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Adentro se ha dicho!

poisson.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Trop petit.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Il m'en faudrait
tout un banc pour me rassasier.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bon. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}En attendant,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je me
contenterai de celui-ci.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0005:}} MIAM !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Neonsalmler zu essen ist nicht

{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}}It's just a sad reputation they got

{{TAG:0003:0002:}}I'm pretty vicious!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bottoms up!

{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}À bien retenir au sujet du piranha :{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}ne pas le manger vivant,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} ou c'est

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bon.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Maintenant que je t'ai bien

Regarde ! {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0026:}}Et Hop !

EN:
Now arowana,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}that'll make{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} for some

good sashimi? No? You should learn!

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}arowana{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} es el acompañante

del pisto manchego.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yo voy a devorar este crudo,
que tengo un hambre canina.
Preparados, listos...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñuk!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}L'arowana,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est parfait pour faire
des sashimis. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Tu sais en faire,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} des
sashimis ?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je te montrerai une prochaine fois.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
J'ai une autre recette en tête pour
celui-là.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MMMM...

Ah, un arowana.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Il sashimi di
arowana{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} è una vera prelibatezza!
Tu lo sai fare il sashimi? No, eh?
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non preoccuparti.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Non mi

così com'è.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}TRIPLO GNAM!

Arowana mı?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ondan{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} nefis sashimi
olur! İyi sashimi yapmayı
biliyor musun? Hayır mı? Öğren!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Neyse,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ben bunu tahmin edeceğin
gibi çiğ götüreceğim. Hadi
bakalım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Now dorado,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}that's a fish {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}you will
really want to fry. Most definitely,
frying is the best way to cook it.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}That said, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}there's nothing wrong
with raw either. No, sir!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!

{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Il paraît que la dorade est délicieuse
quand elle est bien cuite.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}}Mais je ne pourrai jamais en être
sûr,{{TAG:0007:0000:19000000}} {{TAG:0003:0026:}}vu que je m'empresse toujours
de l'engloutir toute crue !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
Ah, la corifena{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}è particolarmente
buona se la fai fritta.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} È il modo
migliore di prepararla, sì.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Detto questo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}non c'è niente di

sempre! Anzi, quasi quasi...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM!

Dorado mu?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Bu balığı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kesinlikle

o.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} çiğ yemekte de yanlış bir

EN:

gar is certainly the best way to eat
it when it's lunch or dinnertime.
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Though {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}it works pretty well if I
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}just swallow it whole too!
No wrong way for fish!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:

cómo preparar un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pez caimán{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}: {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}frito
o a la caldereta.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Pero yo prefiero zampármelo
crudo de un bocado. ¡No hay paz
para los pescados!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñuk!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Oh...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Faire rôtir un gar à la broche,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
au-dessus d'un bon feu au bord de
l'eau...
{{TAG:0003:000D:}}Rien que d'y penser, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}j'en ai l'eau à

Lascia che ti dica questo, {{TAG:000E:0006:08006300610072006F0008006300610072006100}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
Se prepari il luccio friggendolo
in padella, non puoi sbagliare.
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Se sei come me, però, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}puoi anche
mangiarlo crudo{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ingoiandolo in

{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Einen Knochenhecht zu braten, ist
immer eine gute Idee, wenn es Zeit
fürs Abendessen wird.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Es ist aber auch kein Problem für

runterzuschlucken!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}

Bu arada balıkçı dostum,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} gar

güzel oluyor! Balığın yanlış
yenme yolu yok!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

look at the size of it!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heck, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}even I can't down this in one
go, even if I wanted to! Which I DO!

¿Has visto qué tamaño tiene el
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pirarucú{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}¿Cuántas personas harían
falta para merendarse uno entero?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
¡Ni siquiera yo podría con uno de
estos solito!{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aunque ganas no me
faltan... ¡Ñuk!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Je me demande pour combien de
personnes un seul arapaïma peut
servir de repas...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Il faut dire que c'est vraiment un
gros poisson ! {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Trop gros pour moi
tout seul,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} je le crains...
IT:
Secondo te,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}quante persone
si possono sfamare con
un pirarucù?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} È gigantesco!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}È così grande {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}che nemmeno io sono
in grado di mangiarlo! E ti assicuro
che ne ho una voglia matta!

Ich frage mich, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}wie viele Leute von
einem Arapaima satt werden{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Sieh doch nur, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}wie groß der ist!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nicht mal ICH kriege den in einem
Bissen runter, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}so sehr ich auch will.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Und ich WILL!
TRANSLATION:
Merak ettim...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Koca bir arapaima
kaç kişiyi doyurur acaba?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Şunun
boyuna bak! {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yani,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} ben bile bunu
tek lokmada bitiremem. İstesem
de! Ki İSTİYORUM!

¿Crees que el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}bichir ensillado
{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}sería un buen aperitivo?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Je, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}ni siquiera yo tengo el valor

auch getrocknet ausgezeichnet!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber nicht mal ICH schaffe es, einen
Hai in einem Stück zu verschlingen.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ich bin doch kein Wal!
TRANSLATION:
Köpekbalığı dediğin{{TAG:0003:0015:}} kızartmaya
da kurutmaya da güzel gider!
Basit ve net!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama bunu tek
seferde yutmaya ben bile
kalkışmam! Balina mıyım ben?

EN:
With saw sharks,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}a lot of folks like
'em for making fish cakes. Ever had
'em? They're cakes of fish!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But even for me, this guy's too big
to swallow whole. Maybe later!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Algunos carpinteros usan los {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}peces
sierra{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} como herramienta en lugar
de cocinarlos.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}No me extraña. Con lo grandes que
son, ni siquiera yo podría tragarme
uno del tirón. ¡Aunque quién sabe!...
DE:
Manche Leute verarbeiten Sägehaie
zu Fischkuchen!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Schon probiert?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Das sind kleine Kuchen aus Fisch!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ist auch einfacher, als die Biester
im Ganzen zu verschlingen. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Nicht
einmal ICH würde das schaffen!
TRANSLATION:
Testere köpekbalığını{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}balık
köftesi yapmak için kullanan
çoktur. Hiç yedin mi? Bildiğin
balıktan köfte!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama bunu bütün
hâliyle yutmak benim için bile
fazla. Belki sonra!

EN:
Hmm. I wonder,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}do whale sharks
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}taste much like regular sharks?
Or are they a bit more blubbery?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Obviously, even if I tried to eat this
all in one bite—and I did try once—
I couldn't do it!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Just not happening!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Le requin-baleine est plus gros
qu'un requin commun, {{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}}bien sûr,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mais
en fait,{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}} il a le même goût.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Si j'aimerais l'avaler ? {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Oui, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}mais
je ne le ferai pas.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Ce serait de la
gourmandise...
IT:
Mi domando...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Secondo te gli
squali balena{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hanno lo stesso
gusto degli squali normali?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Chissà... Sai, una volta ho provato
a mangiarne uno tutto intero!
Non è finita molto bene...
DE:
Ich wüsste gern, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0017:}}ob Walhaie wie
ganz gewöhnliche Haie schmecken
oder vielleicht etwas herzhafter...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber sogar für MICH ist es
unmöglich, einen Walhai mit
einem Happs zu verschlingen.
TRANSLATION:
Hmmm, merak ettim:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0017:}}Balina
köpekbalığı{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} normal köpekbalığına
mı benzer, yoksa daha yağlı
mıdır?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tek lokmada yemeyi
denesem bile-ki bir kere
denedim-başaramam!{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Olacak iş değil!

ES:
Dicen las malas lenguas que el {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pez
remo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} es soso y grasiento.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} ¡Solo
para los amantes de la fritanga!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}¿Y para qué querría yo merendarme
uno de estos?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Los remos no se
comen; se usan para navegar!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Le poisson-ruban a mauvaise
réputation. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}Sa chair est très amère.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Alors je n'y toucherai pas.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ce ne serait pas la mer à boire, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}tu
me diras,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mais l'amer à manger...
DE:
Über Riemenfische hab ich bisher
nichts Gutes gehört.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Die schmecken
angeblich nur nach Öl!
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Es ist zwar nicht meine Art, mir
einen Fisch durch die Lappen gehen
zu lassen, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}aber diesmal passe ich!
TRANSLATION:
Ooo, kürek balığı hakkında iyi
şeyler duymadım.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Çok yağlı
derler.{{TAG:0003:0028:}} Pek lezzetli değilmiş!
Kötü haber!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0000:}}{{TAG:0003:001B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}O yüzden galiba{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} bunu
yemesem daha iyi. Mantıklı da. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Kürek dediğin çekilir, yenmez!

EN:
I hear coelacanths{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}are too gross to
even THINK about eating! I mean,
these have got to be REALLY old.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}No, thank you. Even I'm not eating
an ancient fish, no matter how big
or rare it may actually be.
ES:
El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}celacanto{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} es un pez del año
catapún, {{TAG:0003:0028:}}¡y tan enorme que no hay
castor que se lo zampe!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ni siquiera yo, con el saque que
tengo, me atrevería a comérmelo,
por grande o raro que sea.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Les cœlacanthes sont des poissons
qui n'ont pas évolué depuis des
centaines de millions d'années.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}C'est une espèce très ancienne et il
en reste très peu. {{TAG:0007:0000:2D000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Je n'en mangerai
donc pas. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Son espèce est protégée.
IT:
Solo l'idea di mangiare un celacanto
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}è abbastanza disgustosa, se ci pensi.
Non è nemmeno vecchio, è antico!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non me la sento proprio di mangiare
un pesce antico, niente da fare...
DE:
Quastenflosser sind so 
unappetitlich,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}} dass ich nicht mal
daran denken will, sie zu essen!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nein danke! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Egal wie groß oder
selten sie auch sind, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}so was kommt
mir nicht zwischen die Zähne!
TRANSLATION:
Sölakantların{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}yemeyi düşünmeye
bile değmeyecek kadar kötü
olduğunu duydum! Sonuçta bunlar
ÇOK yaşlı balıklar.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yok,
teşekkürler. Ne kadar büyük ya
da nadir olursa olsun antika
balık yemem ben bile.

FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Du wakame...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0010:}}Tu savais que
cette algue était comestible ?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Elle est de plus en plus consommée
de par le monde,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} parce qu'elle est
très nutritive. {{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} j'adore !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
Senti qua!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Lo sapevi che le alghe
wakame si mangiano solo
in Giappone, Corea e Cina?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}E dire che sono così buone!
Sono gustose e piene
di minerali!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNA-GNAM!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Wakame wird heutzutage auf der
ganzen Welt gegessen!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Und weißt du, was?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Dank all der
gesunden Mineralstoffe lohnt es
sich, daran rumzunagen!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Harika bir şey duymak ister
misin?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Deniz yosunu artık
dünyanın dört bir yanında
yeniyor!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben de mineral dolu
olduğu için sürekli
atıştırıyorum!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

ES:
Las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}uvas de mar{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} están de vicio.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Casi se deshacen en la boca!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y son tan dulces y carnosas que no
necesitan miel ni endulzantes. ¡Es
imposible comerse una sola!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñam!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:001F:}}Les algues raisins de mer,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} c'est
génial !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Quand on les croque,{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}} les
grains explosent dans la bouche !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Personnellement, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}je préfère les
manger crus quand je les trouve sur
la plage ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}C'est trop bon !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Kriechspross-Algen zu essen fühlt
sich an, als würde man Luftpolster-
folie mit den Zähnen zerdrücken.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nur leckerer!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Deniz üzümü harikadır.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ağzında
baloncuklu naylon gibi patlar!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}
Ben sos falan istemem,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} sudan
çıktığı gibi taptaze! Anladın
mı?{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
When it comes to sea urchins,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}you
can use 'em for sashimi or sushi,
but whatever you do,{{TAG:0003:0015:}} keep 'em raw!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I like them fresh out of the
water! Just watch for the spines,
and you're good as gravy!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
Con los {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}erizos de mar {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}se preparan
platos deliciosos:{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}empanadillas,
croquetas... {{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡incluso sushi!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eso sí, quítales las púas antes de
comerlos para evitar un disgusto.
¡No hagas como yo!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñam!
FR:
Ah, les oursins...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Là-dessus, tout le monde est
d'accord avec moi.{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Il faut les
manger crus le plus vite possible !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Personnellement, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}je préfère prendre
le temps de les ouvrir avant pour ne
pas avaler leurs épines.
Mais j'oublie souvent de le faire.
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM ! AÏAÏAAAÏÏÏÏÏEE !
TRANSLATION:
Denizkestanesini{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}sashimi ya da
sushi yapabilirsin ama ne
yaparsan yap{{TAG:0003:0015:}} çiğ kalsın!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
sudan çıktığı gibi severim!
Dikenlerine dikkat et, gerisi
nefis!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Acorn barnacles{{TAG:0003:0015:}} are really tasty if
you boil them in salt water or try to
season and steam them. Ooh yeah!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}As for me, I'll just be eating them
whole! That's just my way!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Les balanes sont très bonnes
bouillies ou cuites à la vapeur !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je les mange même avec la
coquille,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} tellement je les aime !{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
I denti di cane{{TAG:0003:0015:}} sono buonissimi
sia bolliti in acqua salata
che fatti al vapore! Slurp!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}In ogni caso, ora me li mangio interi.
Che ci vuoi fare? Mi piacciono così!{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM GNAM GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
Palamut midyesi{{TAG:0003:0015:}} tuzlu suda
haşlanınca ya da baharatlanıp
buharda pişince çok güzel olur.
Ooo evet! {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben ise bütün hâliyle
yiyeceğim! Tarzım bu!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Now, for oysters,{{TAG:0003:0015:}} naturally you can
go raw or grilled or even fried. It is
ALL good, you know?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me, I'll always eat 'em whole, just
like I did when I was a pup!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
IT:
Ecco, le ostriche{{TAG:0003:0015:}} si possono
mangiare crude, alla griglia
e anche fritte! Sono fantastiche!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per quanto mi riguarda, le mangerò
intere, proprio come me le dava
la mia mamma da piccolo!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
İstiridye mi?{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Çiğ de olur,
ızgara da, kızartma da. HEPSİ
güzel!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben yavruyken yaptığım
gibi yine bütün yutarım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Turban shells{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}make great sashimi,
but the best is when you grill them
right there in their shells!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You know me, though.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'll just
swallow them whole!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}caracolas espinosas{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} suponen
un estupendo tentempié para matar
el gusanillo.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
¡Y hay incluso quienes se las comen
con concha y todo, como si fueran
simples pipas!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y encima son tan crujientes como
las cortezas.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ¡Deberían venderlas
en bolsitas!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Qué delicia!
FR:
Le turbo,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}c'est très bon en sashimi,
mais c'est peut-être encore meilleur
grillé dans sa coquille !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Moi,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} je ne me casse pas la tête !{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Je
l'avale tout entier et tout cru sans
me poser de questions...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
Con le lumache di mare{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}si fa
un ottimo sashimi. Meglio ancora,
si possono grigliare nel loro guscio!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ma sai come sono fatto.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Io me le
mangio direttamente così.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Manche Leute fragen sich allen
Ernstes, ob man das Haus von
Turbanschnecken mitessen kann!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber du solltest wissen, dass ich
mich mit solchen Belanglosigkeiten
nicht lange aufhalte!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Turban kabuğundan{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}güzel sashimi
olur, ama bence en iyisi
kabuğuyla ızgara!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Beni bilirsin
ama.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Ben bütün yutarım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
With abalone, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}}you can make sashimi,
steam or sauté 'em, or anything.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}It's all good! Go abalone wild!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Not that I mind {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}just eating them like
this!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUMMY YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Te juro por mis dientes que el
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}abulón{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} está para chuparse las patas:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}ya sea al vapor, salteado...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aunque lo cierto es que crudo está
aún más sabrosón.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡A comer!
IT:
Uau, l'abalone!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}} Puoi usarlo per
farne del sashimi, lo puoi fare al
vapore e lo puoi saltare in padella.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}È buono in tutti i modi!{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Io me
lo mangio così com'è, comunque.
"Al naturale", diciamo.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:002B:}}Gedämpfte Seeohren sind ein echter
Gaumenschmaus!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Man kann sie aber
auch sautieren.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Nicht, dass ich was dagegen hätte,
auf jegliche Zubereitungsart zu
verzichten!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM, MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Abalon{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:002B:}} sashimi olur, buharda
pişer, sotelenir, ne istersen.{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
Hepsi güzel! Abalona yüklen!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ben
de{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bunu olduğu gibi yemekten
memnunum!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS NEFİS!

EN:
Ear shells{{TAG:0003:0015:}} are real nice in a stew,
sautéed, or steamed just a wee bit
with some veggies!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}You know me, though.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} I'll just go
and swallow them whole!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Dicen que las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}orejas de mar{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} son
los moluscos más cotillas porque
pegan la oreja en todas partes.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Bromas aparte, lo cierto es que
son un tentempié de aúpa. ¡Me voy
a poner las botas!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Buen provecho!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Les oreilles de mer sont délicieuses
aussi bien grillées que sautées ou
cuites à la vapeur...
{{TAG:0003:0000:}}Quelle cuisson choisir, {{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}}me diras-tu ?{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eh bien je te répondrai que moi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je
ne me casse pas la tête.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Je les avale tout entières et toutes
crues sans me poser de questions.{{TAG:0007:0001:}}
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ohrschnecken kann man in einen
Eintopf geben oder mit etwas
gedämpftem Gemüse servieren!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber ich bin so anspruchslos,
dass ich mir diese hier einfach
roh einverleibe!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Kulak kabuğu{{TAG:0003:0015:}} yahnide, sotede ya
da biraz sebzeyle hafif buharda
güzel olur!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Beni bilirsin.{{TAG:0007:0000:04000000}} Ben
bütün yutarım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Now with your clams,{{TAG:0003:0015:}} you can stew
'em or grill 'em or steam 'em.
Me, I'm a fan of a good chowder.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But then again, I'm perfectly happy
to just swallow them whole, shell
and all! I'm tough like that!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Si quieres preparar una paella de
marisco redonda, prueba a echarle
un puñado de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}almejas orientales{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Lo malo es que hacer una paella es
muy laborioso, ¡y yo soy un castor
impaciente!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Así que adentro!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Une bonne cassolette de palourdes,
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}c'est divin.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais ce que je préfère,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est encore
les manger crues quand je me
promène sur la grève !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM MIAM !
IT:
Le vongole{{TAG:0003:0015:}} si possono fare
alla griglia, in umido... A me
piace molto anche la zuppa!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Comunque, io sono un duro e non
mi faccio problemi a mangiarle
intere così come sono!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
Midyeyi{{TAG:0003:0015:}} yahni de yaparsın,
ızgara da, buharda da. Ben güzel
bir midye çorbasını severim.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama
kabuğuyla bütün yutmaya da
razıyım! Ben dayanıklıyım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}
NEFİS!

EN:
By the by{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}you can dry out the meat
of a pearl oyster for quite a tasty
meal. It's chewy!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Not that I mind{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} just eating them
whole like this!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}ostras perleras{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} secas ganan en
sabor. ¡Diría que saben a cecina!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aunque a mí me pirran crudas, y me
da igual si tienen premio dentro: ¡las
perlas también están ricas!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñam!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Tu sais,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} il y a des pays où l'on
mange la chair de l'huître perlière
après l'avoir fait sécher.
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Ça doit avoir un drôle de goût,{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}}
j'imagine... {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Je ne sais pas si c'est
bon préparé comme ça.
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Ce que je sais par contre, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}c'est que
je n'aurai jamais la patience de les
faire sécher !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mit getrocknetem Perlmuschel-
fleisch kann man viele leckere
Gerichte zaubern!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Man kann sie allerdings auch einfach
hier und jetzt mit allem Drum und
Dran verschlingen!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Bu arada{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}inci istiridyesinin
etini kurutup güzel bir yemek
yapabilirsin. Çiğnemelik!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama
ben{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bunu bütün yemekten de
rahatsız değilim!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
You know,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}scallops make for great
sashimi, or maybe tempura...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}or fried
or sautéed...{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Tasty!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I'm perfectly happy to just swallow
them whole, of course!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
Hay mil y una recetas para preparar
las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}vieiras{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}: {{TAG:0003:002B:}}a la gallega, con jamón,
gratinadas...{{TAG:0003:0015:}} ¡Todo muy sabroso!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Algunos incluso se las comen
crudas! ¿Que quién es tan bruto,
preguntas? ¡Pues yo, claro!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñam!
IT:
Sai,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}se ti piace la cucina giapponese,
con le capesante ci puoi fare
del sashimi o del tempura...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Altrimenti le puoi sempre fare fritte
o saltate in padella! {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Io comunque me
le mangerò così come sono!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
Biliyor musun,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:002B:}}deniz tarağından
sashimi de olur, tempura da...{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
kızartma ya da sote de...{{TAG:0003:0015:}} Hepsi
nefis!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben tabii bütün yutmaktan
da memnunum!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
So I hear sea anemone{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}goes really
great in miso soup. Ever hear this?
It's got a real crisp texture!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But, you know,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} I think I'll hold off
on this guy. Don't quite have the
stomach for it just yet.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Una sopita de {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}anémona{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, además
de estar de rechupete, revitaliza
cuerpo y mente. ¿Lo sabías?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sin que sirva de precedente, voy
a pasar de comerme esta, que no
tengo el estómago para fiestas.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}J'ai souvent entendu dire que
l'anémone de mer était succulente
en soupe...
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Sa texture est croustillante comme
un croûton.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Mais je n'en ferai pas
aujourd'hui,{{TAG:0007:0000:0C000000}} je n'en ai pas le temps.
IT:
Ho sentito dire{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}che c'è chi si mangia
gli anemoni di mare mettendoli
nella zuppa! Pazzesco, eh?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Persino io{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} non sono proprio sicuro
di volerli provare... {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Sono una delle
poche cose che preferisco evitare!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Seeanemonen sollen eine ziemlich
gute Suppeneinlage hergeben.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wobei ich zugeben muss, dass ich
dieses kleine Kerlchen hier nicht
mal roh anrühren werde.
TRANSLATION:
Deniz şakayığının{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}miso
çorbasında çok iyi olduğunu
duydum. Duydun mu hiç? Kıtır bir
dokusu varmış!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama şey,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} ben bunu
şimdilik pas geçeceğim. Midem
henüz hazır değil.

EN:
Now sea stars—{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}people say you
shouldn't eat these guys. Not tasty,
apparently! Quite a harsh critique!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeah, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}I think I'll listen to common
opinion just this once. I'm not quite
crazy enough to eat a sea star!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}La gente recomienda no comer
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}estrellas de mar{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} porque no están
nada sabrosas y además pican.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Por una vez voy a hacer caso de las
habladurías. ¡Ni siquiera yo estoy
tan loco como para comerme una!
FR:
Une étoile de mer... {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}C'est mignon
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}mais ce n'est pas vraiment
comestible.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Je crois que je vais passer mon
tour, cette fois.
IT:
A quanto pare,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}le stelle marine
non sono molto buone da mangiare.
Triste ma vero, ahimè!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Per una volta, {{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}penso che
mi tratterrò dall'abbuffarmi.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Die meisten Leute raten davon ab,
Seesterne zu essen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Angeblich sind
sie alles andere als lecker...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich glaube, ich vertraue dieses eine
Mal auf die Meinung der Mehrheit
und verzichte!
TRANSLATION:
Denizyıldızına gelince...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0028:}}
İnsanlar bunları yemeyin diyor.
Lezzetli değilmiş! Acımasız
yorum!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Evet,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} bu kez çoğunluğa
kulak vereceğim. Denizyıldızı
yiyecek kadar da deli değilim!

EN:
Man, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}my hat goes off to whoever
was the first to eat a sea cucumber!
Sounds like a good idea, though...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeah,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} I don't think I'll be joining the
sea-cuke club anytime today! Maybe
not tomorrow either!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡Me quito el sombrero ante la
primera persona -o castor- que se
atrevió a comer un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}pepino de mar{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sí, puede sonar delicioso,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} pero de
vegetal solo tiene el nombre: ¡en
realidad es una babosa! ¡Puaj!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Un concombre de mer...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Je n'aime pas tellement les légumes
en fait,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} alors la première fois qu'on
m'en a apporté un,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} j'ai hésité...
{{TAG:0003:001B:}}Maintenant je sais que c'est un
animal,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} mais le nom me rebute...{{TAG:0007:0000:2D000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Non, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}vraiment, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ça ne me dit rien...
IT:
Uau! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Non riesco a credere che
qualcuno abbia mai avuto il coraggio
di mangiarsi un cetriolo di mare!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Buon per lui,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} chiunque sia stato!
Io non credo di sentirmela, ecco.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Hut ab vor demjenigen, der als
Erster eine Seegurke gegessen hat!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Das ist nicht jedermanns Sache...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich habe jedenfalls nicht vor,
in absehbarer Zeit Mitglied im
Seegurken-Club zu werden!
TRANSLATION:
Vay be,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0015:}} denizhıyarını ilk yiyen
kişiye şapka çıkarırım! Fikir o
kadar da kötü değil gerçi...{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}
bugün denizhıyarı kulübüne
katılmayacağım. Yarın da pek sanmıyorum!

EN:
From what my excellent sources tell
me,{{TAG:0003:0015:}} you CAN eat boiled sea slugs,
though some are still poisonous.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yeah, I...{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}I don't think I'll chance it!
Besides, who wants to eat a SLUG?
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Mi contacto afirma que las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}babosas
de mar{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} cocidas son comestibles,
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}aunque algunas mantienen el veneno.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Creo que esta vez no voy a tentar
a la suerte... Además, ¿quién quiere
llenarse el buche con BABOSAS?
FR:
{{TAG:0003:000B:}}Certaines limaces de mer sont
toxiques,{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} alors il vaut mieux être
prudent.
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Dans le doute, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je préfère ne pas m'y
risquer...
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ich habe gehört, dass es durchaus
Leute gibt, die Nacktkiemer essen,
obwohl manche davon giftig sind.
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Ich fordere mein Glück lieber nicht
heraus...{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Besonders appetitlich
sehen die sowieso nicht aus.
TRANSLATION:
Güvenilir kaynaklarıma göre{{TAG:0003:0015:}}
deniz tavşanı haşlanınca
yenebiliyormuş, ama bazıları
zehirli.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Evet, ben...{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}} riske
atmayayım! Hem kim SOLUCANIMSI
bir şey yemek ister?

ES:
¿{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Gusanos políclados{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0028:}}Puaj, qué
ascazo. Ningún castor en su sano
juicio se alimentaría de esas cosas.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Paso olímpicamente de probarlos
siquiera!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0028:}}Um Meerstrudelwürmer mache ich
lieber einen großen Bogen.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Diese
Dinger sind mir zu glitschig{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ja, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}richtig gehört!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Die sind nichts für mich!

ES:
Las {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}langostas mantis{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} son uno de
mis aperitivos favoritos. {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Las fríes
y quedan la mar de crujientes.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Naturalmente, crudas también son
toda una delicia...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡A la panza!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Fangschreckenkrebse sind sowohl
frittiert als auch gekocht ein
echter Leckerbissen.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Was aber nicht heißt, dass sie roh
weniger köstlich sind!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}
TRANSLATION:
Mmm, mantis karidesi.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Buna
varım. {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Kızartması da haşlaması
da nefis olur.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Çiğ servis
edilirse de hayır demem tabii!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}
NEFİS!

EN:
Sweet shrimp{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}make great sashimi,
but try 'em deep fried as soon as
you get the chance!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Me? {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I'm just gonna gulp 'em down
as they are now!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}camarón boreal{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} no puede faltar
en todo buen sarao, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}¡especialmente
frito o a la gabardina!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aunque los castores los preferimos
crudos...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Buen provecho!
FR:
Ah, une crevette nordique...{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}En
sashimi, ou en beignet !{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Mais moi,
les crevettes, je les gobe.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
Il gamberetto boreale{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}come sashimi
non è niente male, ma è ancora
più buono se lo fai fritto!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ad ogni modo, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}io me lo mangio
così com'è!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM! GNA-GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
Tatlı karides{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}sashimi için
harikadır, ama fırsat bulunca
kızartmasını da dene!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
Ben bunları şimdi oldukları gibi
yutacağım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Spiny lobsters{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}are usually best
boiled or grilled. Oh yes! Either way
you're set! Delicious!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}That said, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}swallowing them whole
works perfectly fine too!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
TRANSLATION:
Dikenli ıstakoz{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}genelde haşlama
ya da ızgarada en güzel olur.
Ooo evet! İkisi de şahane!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
bütün hâliyle yutmak da gayet
işe yarar!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

ES:
Los {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}bogavantes{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} son un auténtico
manjar de reyes, {{TAG:0003:0015:}}de ahí que se
sirvan en galas y recepciones.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Y seguro que nunca has visto a
nadie comerse uno entero de un
bocado.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Pues atent{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Ein Hummer bleibt ein Hummer, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}egal
ob gekocht, gegrillt oder gedämpft.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dass ich ihn am liebsten roh
verschlinge, ist jedoch ein
offenes Geheimnis!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MJAM!{{TAG:0007:0008:28000000}}

EN:
Snow crabs!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}They're great whether
boiled, grilled, or steamed.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}But {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I'm just gonna go ahead and
swallow them whole!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
Los palitos de cangrejo están de
rechupete,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}y si encima son de
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cangrejo de nieve{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, ya ni te cuento.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}A mí lo que más me gusta es roer
sus patas. ¡Me lo paso mejor que
pelando cacahuetes!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡A comer!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}« Crabe des neiges » est un drôle de
nom pour un animal qui se déguste
chaud.
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}C'est aussi pour ça que moi, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}je le
mange froid. {{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}Cru,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} en fait.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !
IT:
Il granchio della neve{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}è buono
bollito, grigliato e anche al vapore!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Idea! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}E se me lo mangiassi intero,
invece? Proviamo!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
Kar yengeci!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}Haşlama, ızgara ya
da buharda fark etmez, hepsi
güzel.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}} Ama{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ben bütün hâliyle
yutacağım!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Hmm. Horsehair crab{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}meat is
obviously tasty,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} but man, those
crab innards are REALLY good too!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Well, anyway,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'll just swallow it all
in one bite! Saves time!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Todo el mundo coincide en que la
carne del {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cangrejo peludo {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}es pura
ambrosía.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
Hay a quien le gusta acariciarlo
porque le hace cosquillas en las
patas.{{TAG:0003:0001:}} ¡Bah, cursilerías!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Adentro!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Le crabe velu,{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} c'est vraiment super
bon.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}En plus, {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}ses poils te chatouillent la
gorge quand tu l'avales !{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}MIAM !{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
HI HI !
TRANSLATION:
Hmmm. Kıllı yengecin{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}eti zaten
lezzetli,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} ama iç organları da
GERÇEKTEN iyidir!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Neyse,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hepsini
tek lokmada yutayım. Zaman
kazandırır!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Your red king crab{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}is great boiled,
steamed, or grilled.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} You really
can't mess it up!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Well, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I guess I'll just gulp this guy
down in one big bite!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}Sí, habría que ser redomadamente
mal cocinero para pifiarla al
preparar un {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cangrejo boreal{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
Y es tan grande que lo puedes
compartir... si quieres. {{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Pero no
es mi caso!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Adentro!
IT:
Questo granchio gigante{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}sarebbe
buono sia bollito che al vapore.
O anche grigliato, eh!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ma voglio stupirti! {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}Guarda come
me lo mangio in un sol boccone!
Pronti? VIA!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}GNAM GNAM GNAM!
TRANSLATION:
Kırmızı kral yengeç{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}haşlama,
buharda ya da ızgarada harika
olur.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} Yanlış yapmak neredeyse
imkânsız!{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} {{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ben ise{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} bunu tek
lokmada hüpleteyim!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}NEFİS!

EN:
Spider crab?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} {{TAG:0003:0015:}}You gotta definitely
steam it. Steaming is just such a
simple way to cook things, right?
{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I mean, {{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}I'm just gonna eat it totally
raw, though. Feel free to follow my
example, but I'm eating NOW.{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}YUM!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0015:}}El {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}cangrejo gigante japonés {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}es una
exquisitez, {{TAG:0003:0028:}}pero se necesita una olla
de tamaño industrial para cocinarlo.{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Yo paso de complicaciones y me lo
voy a comer crudo. Puedes seguir
mi ejemplo, si quieres...{{TAG:0007:0001:}} {{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Ñam!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0009:}}Un crabe-araignée géant...{{TAG:0007:0000:2D000000}} J'avoue
